race.comment: SYMPHONITE (4) doesn't win out of turn, scoring just once from 15 starts. Again tasted defeat last start when fourth over 1000m at Dubbo, beaten 1.2 lengths. Beautifully placed and is sure to take a ton of beating. ELDERBERRY WINE (3) ran well despite being friendless in betting last time over 1000m at Dubbo, finishing second and beaten a long neck at $51. Has the pace to be in a prominent position from the outset. Expecting a bold showing. QUASIMOTO (1) progressed nicely last time out to finish just a neck from the winner in second over 1200m at Narromine after being in contention on the corner. Has the class to build on that encouraging effort last start. OUTLAW ANNIE (2) comes here off a break of six-and-a-half months. Worth noting she filled a minor placing when returning from a spell last time in work over 1000m at Gilgandra. Worth plenty of thought.
